verdict.rationale: Flagsmith docs explicitly describe multivariate flags with percentage-weighted variants and remote config values, and core management docs show configurable flag fields (not just boolean toggles) plus experimentation using multivariate flags. This is corroborated by a self-hosted probe showing a real flag create/evaluate roundtrip. missing for 10: explicit doc confirmation of string/number/JSON config value types beyond variant weighting, and independent hands-on confirmation of non-boolean config value retrieval via SDK.
